verses.original: וּבְהַפִּֽילְכֶ֨ם אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַיהוָ֥ה׀ קֹדֶשׁ֮ מִן־ הָאָרֶץ֒ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף קֹדֶשׁ־ ה֥וּא בְכָל־ גְּבוּלָ֖הּ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·hap·pî·lə·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ bə·na·ḥă·lāh tā·rî·mū ṯə·rū·māh Yah·weh qō·ḏeš min- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ō·reḵ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’ō·reḵ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘ă·śā·rāh ’ā·lep̄ qō·ḏeš- hū ḇə·ḵāl- gə·ḇū·lāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance you are to set aside a portion for the LORD a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits . . . . . . . . . long and 20,000 cubits . . . wide This entire tract of land . . . will be holy
verses.literalPt: Demais, quando repartirdes a terra em herança por sortes, oferecereis uma oblação a Jeová, uma santa porção da terra; o comprimento será o comprimento de vinte e cinco mil canas, e a largura será de dez mil. Ela será santa em todo o seu termo ao redor.

verses.original: יִהְיֶ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע סָבִ֑יב וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yeh miz·zeh ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ba·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ mə·rub·bā‘ sā·ḇîḇ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh miḡ·rāš lōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Within this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 cubits . . . square with 50 cubits around it for open land
verses.literalPt: Dessa porção o santuário ocupará quinhentas canas de comprimento e quinhentas de largura, em quadro ao redor; e os seus subúrbios terão cinquenta cúbitos ao redor.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַמִּדָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּבֽוֹ־ יִהְיֶ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- ham·mid·dāh haz·zōṯ tā·mō·wḏ ’ō·reḵ ḥă·mēš wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·ḇōw- yih·yeh ham·miq·dāš qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: From this holy portion you are to measure off a length of 25,000 cubits . . . . . . and a width of 10,000 cubits . . . and in it will be the sanctuary the Most Holy Place
verses.literalPt: Dessa medida medirás vinte e cinco mil canas de comprimento e dez mil de largura; e nela será o santuário, que é santíssimo.

verses.original: קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן־ הָאָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַכֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה הַקְּרֵבִ֖ים לְשָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לְבָ֣תִּ֔ים וּמִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·ḏeš min- hā·’ā·reṣ hū lak·kō·hă·nîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê ham·miq·dāš yih·yeh haq·qə·rê·ḇîm lə·šā·rêṯ ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh lā·hem mā·qō·wm lə·ḇāt·tîm ū·miq·dāš lam·miq·dāš
verses.literal: It will be a holy portion of the land . . . to be used by the priests who minister in the sanctuary who draw near to minister before the LORD It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy area for the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: É ela uma santa porção da terra; será para os sacerdotes, ministros do santuário, que se aproximam para servir a Jeová; e lhes servirá de lugar para as suas casas e de lugar santo para o santuário.

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב יִהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת לָהֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’ō·reḵ wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm rō·ḥaḇ yih·yɛh lal·wî·yim mə·šā·rə·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ lā·hem la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh ‘eś·rîm lə·šā·ḵōṯ
verses.literal: An adjacent area 25,000 cubits . . . . . . long and 10,000 cubits . . . wide shall belong to the Levites who minister in the temple . . . it will be their possession for towns in which to live . . .
verses.literalPt: Os levitas, ministros da casa, terão vinte e cinco mil canas de comprimento e dez mil de largura, para possessão sua, para vinte câmaras.

verses.original: וַאֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָעִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr tit·tə·nū ḥă·mê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm rō·ḥaḇ wə·’ō·reḵ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ lə·‘um·maṯ tə·rū·maṯ haq·qō·ḏeš lə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl yih·yeh
verses.literal: As the property of the city you are to set aside an area 5,000 cubits . . . wide and 25,000 cubits . . . . . . long adjacent to the holy district It will belong to the whole house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Para a possessão da cidade, dareis cinco mil canas de largura e vinte e cinco mil de comprimento, ao lado da oblação da santa porção, o que será para toda a casa de Israel.

verses.original: וְלַנָּשִׂ֡יא מִזֶּ֣ה וּמִזֶּה֩ לִתְרוּמַ֨ת הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֗יר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת־ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְאֶל־ פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר מִפְּאַת־ יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּה וּמִפְּאַת־ קֵ֖דְמָה קָדִ֑ימָה וְאֹ֗רֶךְ לְעֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַחֲלָקִ֔ים מִגְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lan·nā·śî miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh liṯ·rū·maṯ haq·qō·ḏeš wə·la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr ’el- pə·nê ṯə·rū·maṯ- haq·qō·ḏeš wə·’el- pə·nê ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr mip·pə·’aṯ- yām yām·māh ū·mip·pə·’aṯ- qê·ḏə·māh qā·ḏî·māh wə·’ō·reḵ lə·‘um·mō·wṯ ’a·ḥaḏ ha·ḥă·lā·qîm mig·gə·ḇūl yām ’el- gə·ḇūl qā·ḏî·māh
verses.literal: Now the prince will have the area bordering each side of the area formed by - . . . the holy district - and the property of the city extending westward from the western side and eastward from the eastern side running lengthwise from the western . . . boundary to the eastern boundary and parallel to one of the tribal portions
verses.literalPt: O que se der ao príncipe estará duma e da outra parte da santa oblação e da possessão da cidade, defronte da santa oblação e defronte da possessão da cidade, do lado ocidental, para o ocidente, e do lado oriental para o oriente; e de comprimento corresponderá a uma das porções desde o termo ocidental até o termo oriental.

verses.original: לָאָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ לַֽאֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־ יוֹנ֨וּ ע֤וֹד נְשִׂיאַי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְהָאָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·’ā·reṣ yih·yeh- lōw la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- yō·w·nū ‘ō·wḏ nə·śî·’ay ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·hā·’ā·reṣ yit·tə·nū lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·šiḇ·ṭê·hem
verses.literal: This land will be his possession in Israel And My princes will no longer oppress My people but will give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes
verses.literalPt: Na terra lhe será um possessão em Israel; os meus príncipes não oprimirão mais o meu povo, mas distribuirão a terra pela casa de Israel, segundo as suas tribos.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה רַב־ לָכֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חָמָ֤ס וָשֹׁד֙ הָסִ֔ירוּ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל עַמִּ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh raḇ- lā·ḵem nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ hā·sî·rū ū·miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ‘ă·śū hā·rî·mū ḡə·ru·šō·ṯê·ḵem mê·‘al ‘am·mî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Enough O princes of Israel Cease your violence and oppression and do what is just and right Stop dispossessing . . . My people declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Baste-vos, príncipes de Israel; cessai da violência e rapina e executai juízo e justiça; tirai do meu povo as vossas exações, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: מֹֽאזְנֵי־ צֶ֧דֶק וְאֵֽיפַת־ צֶ֛דֶק וּבַת־ צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·zə·nê- ṣe·ḏeq wə·’ê·p̄aṯ- ṣe·ḏeq ū·ḇaṯ- ṣe·ḏeq yə·hî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You must use honest scales a just ephah and a just bath
verses.literalPt: Tereis balanças justas, e efa justo, e bato justo.

verses.original: הָאֵיפָ֣ה וְהַבַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה לָשֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַחֹ֖מֶר הַבָּ֑ת וַעֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה אֶל־ הַחֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ê·p̄āh wə·hab·baṯ tō·ḵen ’e·ḥāḏ yih·yeh lā·śêṯ ma‘·śar ha·ḥō·mer hab·bāṯ wa·‘ă·śî·riṯ ha·ḥō·mer hā·’ê·p̄āh ’el- ha·ḥō·mer yih·yeh maṯ·kun·tōw
verses.literal: The ephah and the bath shall be the same quantity so that the bath will contain a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer the homer will be the standard measure for both
verses.literalPt: O efa e o bato serão duma só medida, de maneira que o bato contenha a décima parte dum ômer, e o efa, a décima parte dum ômer; conforme o ômer, será a sua medida.

verses.original: וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַחֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל הַמָּנֶ֖ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·še·qel ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh ‘eś·rîm šə·qā·lîm ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm šə·qā·lîm ‘ă·śā·rāh wa·ḥă·miš·šāh še·qel ham·mā·neh yih·yeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The shekel will consist of twenty gerahs Twenty shekels plus twenty-five . . . shekels plus fifteen . . . shekels will equal one mina
verses.literalPt: O siclo terá vinte óbolos. O vosso mane será vinte siclos, vinte e cinco siclos e quinze siclos.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַתְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָֽאֵיפָה֙ מֵחֹ֣מֶר הַֽחִטִּ֔ים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה מֵחֹ֖מֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hat·tə·rū·māh ’ă·šer tā·rî·mū šiš·šîṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh mê·ḥō·mer ha·ḥiṭ·ṭîm wə·šiš·šî·ṯem hā·’ê·p̄āh mê·ḥō·mer haś·śə·‘ō·rîm
verses.literal: This is the contribution you are to offer a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley
verses.literalPt: Esta é a oblação que haveis de oferecer: a sexta parte dum efa de cada ômer de trigo, e dareis a sexta parte dum efa de cada ômer de cevada;

verses.original: וְחֹ֨ק הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן הַבַּ֣ת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַבַּת֙ מִן־ הַכֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי־ עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥōq haš·še·men hab·baṯ haš·še·men ma‘·śar hab·baṯ min- hak·kōr ‘ă·śe·reṯ hab·bat·tîm ḥō·mer kî- ‘ă·śe·reṯ hab·bat·tîm ḥō·mer
verses.literal: The prescribed portion of oil measured by the bath . . . is a tenth of a bath from each cor a cor consists of ten baths or one homer since ten baths are equivalent to a homer
verses.literalPt: a porção determinada de azeite, do bato de azeite, será a décima parte dum bato tirado do coro, que é dez batos, a saber, o ômer; pois dez batos fazem um ômer;

verses.original: וְשֶׂה־ אַחַ֨ת מִן־ הַצֹּ֤אן מִן־ הַמָּאתַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִנְחָ֖ה וּלְעוֹלָ֣ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śeh- ’a·ḥaṯ min- haṣ·ṣōn min- ham·mā·ṯa·yim mim·maš·qêh yiś·rā·’êl lə·min·ḥāh ū·lə·‘ō·w·lāh wə·liš·lā·mîm lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And one sheep shall be given from each flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel These are for the grain offerings burnt offerings and peace offerings to make atonement for the people declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: um cordeiro do rebanho, de cada duzentos, das bem regadas pastagens de Israel; para ofertas de cereais, e para holocaustos, e para ofertas pacíficas, a fim de fazer expiação por eles, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הָעָ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ יִהְי֖וּ אֶל־ הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לַנָּשִׂ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōl hā·‘ām hā·’ā·reṣ yih·yū ’el- hat·tə·rū·māh haz·zōṯ lan·nā·śî bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: All the people of the land must participate in this contribution for the prince in Israel
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo da terra concorrerá a essa oblação para o príncipe em Israel.

verses.original: וְעַֽל־ הַנָּשִׂ֣יא יִהְיֶ֗ה הָעוֹל֣וֹת וְהַמִּנְחָה֮ וְהַנֵּסֶךְ֒ בַּחַגִּ֤ים וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים֙ וּבַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת בְּכָֽל־ מוֹעֲדֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֽוּא־ יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֶת־ הַחַטָּ֣את וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הָֽעוֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים לְכַפֵּ֖ר בְּעַ֥ד בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- han·nā·śî yih·yeh hā·‘ō·w·lō·wṯ wə·ham·min·ḥāh wə·han·nê·seḵ ba·ḥag·gîm ū·ḇe·ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·ḇaš·šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ bə·ḵāl mō·w·‘ă·ḏê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hū- ya·‘ă·śeh ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·lā·mîm lə·ḵap·pêr bə·‘aḏ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And it shall be the prince’s part to provide the burnt offerings grain offerings and drink offerings for the feasts New Moons and Sabbaths for all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel He will provide the sin offerings grain offerings burnt offerings and peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Tocará ao príncipe dar os holocaustos, e as ofertas de cereais, e as ofertas de libações, nas festas e nas luas novas e nos sábados, em todas as festas fixas da casa de Israel. Ele preparará a oferta pelo pecado, e a oferta de cereais, e o holocausto, e as ofertas pacíficas, para fazer expiação pela casa de Israel.

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ תִּקַּ֥ח פַּר־ בֶּן־ בָּקָ֖ר תָּמִ֑ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֖ אֶת־ הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bā·ri·šō·wn bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš tiq·qaḥ par- ben- bā·qār tā·mîm wə·ḥiṭ·ṭê·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·miq·dāš
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says On the first day of the first month you are to take a young bull . . . . . . without blemish and purify the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: No primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, tomarás um bezerro sem mancha e purificarás o santuário.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֣ם הַחַטָּ֗את וְנָתַן֙ אֶל־ מְזוּזַ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּ֛ע פִּנּ֥וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֖ה לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעַ֨ל־ מְזוּזַ֔ת שַׁ֖עַר הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·nā·ṯan ’el- mə·zū·zaṯ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·’el- ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hā·‘ă·zā·rāh lam·miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘al- mə·zū·zaṯ ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ
verses.literal: And the priest is to take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple on the four corners of the ledge of the altar and on the gateposts . . . of the inner court
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote tomará do sangue da oferta pelo pecado e pô-lo-á nas ombreiras da casa, e nos quatro cantos das seções do altar, e nos postes da porta do átrio interior.

verses.original: וְכֵ֤ן תַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה בַחֹ֔דֶשׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ שֹׁגֶ֖ה וּמִפֶּ֑תִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śeh bə·šiḇ·‘āh ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš mê·’îš šō·ḡeh ū·mip·pe·ṯî wə·ḵip·par·tem ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: You must do the same thing on the seventh day of the month for anyone who strays unintentionally or in ignorance In this way you will make atonement for the temple
verses.literalPt: Assim farás no sétimo dia do mês a favor de cada um que erra e do que é simples; assim, fareis expiação pela casa.

verses.original: בָּ֠רִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַפָּ֑סַח חָ֕ג שְׁבֻע֣וֹת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ri·šō·wn bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem hap·pā·saḥ ḥāḡ šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ yā·mîm maṣ·ṣō·wṯ yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: On the fourteenth . . . day of the first month you are to observe the Passover a feast of seven days during which unleavened bread shall be eaten
verses.literalPt: No primeiro mês, aos quatorze dias do mês, tereis uma Páscoa, festa de sete dias; comer-se-ão pães asmos.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַנָּשִׂיא֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא בַּעֲד֕וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ פַּ֖ר חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh han·nā·śî bay·yō·wm ha·hū ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ par ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land
verses.literalPt: Nesse dia, o príncipe preparará para si e para todo o povo da terra um novilho como oferta pelo pecado.

verses.original: וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵֽי־ הֶחָ֜ג יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה עוֹלָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת פָּ֠רִים וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֵילִ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ לַיּ֔וֹם שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְחַטָּ֕את שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים לַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ yə·mê- he·ḥāḡ ya·‘ă·śeh ‘ō·w·lāh Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ pā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ê·lîm tə·mî·mim lay·yō·wm šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm wə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm lay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Each day during the seven days of the feast he shall provide seven bulls and seven rams without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD - along with a male goat . . . for a sin offering
verses.literalPt: Durante os sete dias da festa, preparará um holocausto a Jeová, sete novilhos e sete carneiros sem mancha, cada dia durante os sete dias; e um bode cada dia como oferta pelo pecado.

verses.original: וּמִנְחָ֗ה אֵיפָ֥ה לַפָּ֛ר וְאֵיפָ֥ה לָאַ֖יִל יַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥāh ’ê·p̄āh lap·pār wə·’ê·p̄āh lā·’a·yil ya·‘ă·śeh wə·še·men hîn lā·’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain
verses.literalPt: Prepará uma oferta de cereais, um efa para cada novilho, e um efa para cada carneiro, e um him de azeite para cada efa.

verses.original: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֡י בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בֶּחָ֔ג יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָאֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּעֹלָ֔ה וְכַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְכַשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס
verses.transliteration: baš·šə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš be·ḥāḡ ya·‘ă·śeh ḵā·’êl·leh šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ kā·‘ō·lāh wə·ḵam·min·ḥāh wə·ḵaš·šā·men
verses.literal: During the seven days of the feast that begins on the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month he is to make the same provision . . . for sin offerings burnt offerings grain offerings and oil
verses.literalPt: No sétimo mês, aos quinze dias do mês, na festa, fará o mesmo por sete dias, segundo a oferta pelo pecado, segundo o holocausto e segundo a oferta de cereais, segundo o azeite.
